channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Block employee says the company dangled a 75% pay raise to get her to stay after layoffs — but she decided to quit
item.description: "I saw my company discard half of my peers and double my pay," the former Block employee wrote. "That's not an honor. It feels shameful."

item.title: The internet is roasting these 4 young Wall Streeters for a glossy magazine spread. One of them is brushing it off.
item.description: Demarre Johnson is one of four Wall Street juniors profiled in a now-viral, meme-ified article. He knew that "controversy sells."

item.title: I'm a British mom in the US who only connected with other Brits. Now, in my 50s, my closest friends are American.
item.description: Homesickness and the feeling of being an outsider led Madeleine Collins to connect with other British women while raising her daughters in San Diego.

item.title: Sam Altman is stuck playing defense. It all started a week ago.
item.description: OpenAI's debacle is arguably its least technical challenge yet. It also means Sam Altman can't just push out an app update to alleviate the issue.

item.title: Dario Amodei says Anthropic is having 'productive conversations' with the Pentagon despite being effectively blacklisted
item.description: After Amodei's statement, Department of War official Emil Michael said in an X post that there is "no active @DeptofWar negotiation" with Anthropic.

item.title: Amazon is back up after outage affecting tens of thousands of shoppers
item.description: Shoppers are reporting Amazon on Downdetector, saying the problems ranged from checkout and payment failures to incorrect or fluctuating prices.

item.title: Conan O'Brien, 62, says overcoming career setbacks comes down to one mindset
item.description: Conan O'Brien said he thought his career was over at different stages, from fearing he wouldn't get into his dream college to thinking critics were right about his future on the "Late Night" show.

item.title: Zelenskyy said the US asked Ukraine for support in fighting off Iran's Shahed drones, so he's sending experts their way
item.description: Zelenskyy said Ukraine will provide the US with specialists and resources to protect against the drones in its fight in the Middle East.

item.title: Microsoft says Anthropic's products can stay on its platforms after lawyers 'studied' the Pentagon supply chain risk designation
item.description: Microsoft says Anthropic's AI tools can remain on its platforms after lawyers reviewed the Pentagon's supply chain risk designation.

item.title: China's smartest students used to chase tech and finance jobs. Now, they're choosing manufacturing.
item.description: New data from Tsinghua university shows more top Chinese graduates choosing manufacturing and energy jobs.
